# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Tells Seth of the Covenant

---

**15:1** 'After the transgression, God said to me: "Because you have listened to your wife and eaten of the tree of which I commanded you not to eat, cursed is the earth in your works. In toil and in the sweat of your face you shall eat bread all the days of your life."'

**15:2** 'And the Lord God made garments of skins for me and for Eve my wife, and he clothed us.'

**15:3** 'And he said: "Behold, Adam has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now lest he put out his hand and take also of the tree of life and eat and live for ever." And he sent us out of paradise.'

**15:4** 'And at the gate of paradise he placed the cherubim and a flaming sword to guard the way to the tree of life.'

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
